events.name: The Shopkeeper Who Knows You
events.intro: "Back again? Marta says regulars get the good stool." The shopkeeper wipes the counter and waits to see what you do.

success.text: "A fair customer!" She writes your name in the little book by the till.
You swap stories. She marks you down as a friend, not just a customer.
She shrugs. "Window shoppers pay in smiles."

events.name: Loyalty Has Its Perks
events.intro: "For regulars only." The shopkeeper slides a plain box across the counter. "Mystery discount. Do not tell the others."

success.text: Inside: something useful, at a price you will not forget.
"You are too honest for this business." She presses a berry into your hand anyway.

events.name: A Gift for the Back Room
events.intro: The shopkeeper is polishing a shelf that has nothing on it. "Someone is missing from this shelf," she says, not looking at you.

success.text: Her eyes go wide. She unlocks a door behind the counter. "Secret stock. Come in."

effects.text: The shopkeeper opened a secret back room for you.

success.text: She weighs it in her palm and smiles. The back room is yours.
"Another time," she says, and the shelf stays empty.

events.name: Two Stalls, One Grudge
events.intro: Two merchants have set up carts ten steps apart and are shouting prices at each other. Each one wants you to buy from them first.

choices.label: Buy from the one in red (₽120)

success.text: The one in red beams. The other one mutters about "traitors", but waves anyway.

choices.label: Buy from the one in green (₽120)

success.text: The one in green bows. The other pretends not to see.
You get them to share a stall for a day. Both are grudgingly impressed.

failure.text: They both lose patience and shout at you instead.

events.name: The Barter Market
events.intro: In a cellar, nobody takes money. A sign says: THINGS FOR THINGS. A figure in a cloak points at your Bag.

choices.label: Trade a Big Mushroom for a Rare Candy

success.text: No questions asked. The figure nods once.

choices.label: Trade a Pearl for a Focus Sash

success.text: The cloak slides a sash across the table. "Keep it hidden."

choices.label: Trade a Star Piece for Leftovers

success.text: A good trade by anyone's count.
The cellar door closes behind you.

events.name: The Peddler Returns: Her First Cart
events.intro: "Hello! I am Wicker, and I sell everything that fell off other people's wagons." She has a cart, a limp, and a very good laugh.

success.text: "Best in the region. Possibly the only." She hums as she packs it.
It takes an hour. She remembers it.

events.name: The Peddler Returns: A Better Cart
events.intro: Wicker's cart has a new wheel and a new sign. "Look who I found on the road! I have been telling everyone about you."

success.text: She was a Champion's assistant once, she says, until the Champion stopped needing help. She laughs it off. You do not.
She gives you the good stock, quietly.

events.name: The Peddler Returns: The Last Delivery
events.intro: Wicker waits at a crossroads with a wrapped box. "Last delivery of my career. I want you to have the reason I started."

success.text: Inside: an old map and a charm. "Go see everything. Then tell me."

effects.text: Wicker the peddler gave you her lucky charm.

success.text: She laughs until she cries, then gives you a hug instead.

events.name: Rumours for Sale
events.intro: A man with a satchel full of folded notes: "Rumours, ₽100 apiece! Some are even true."

choices.label: Buy a rumour about the road (₽100)

success.text: "The next fork is safer to the left." You glimpse the road ahead.

choices.label: Buy a rumour about the gym (₽200)

success.text: "The leader favours a certain type." He is almost certainly right.

choices.label: Trade a rumour of your own

success.text: You tell him something true. He writes it down and gives you change.

events.name: The Pawn Shop Loupe
events.intro: A pawn shop with a tiny brass loupe on a chain. "Bring me anything old. I will tell you what it is worth, and what it really is."

success.text: He squints, whistles, and offers a fair price.
The loupe says it is older than the town.

choices.label: Learn how to use the loupe (Intelligence)

success.text: You spot the tiny cracks that make a fake. The owner is impressed.

failure.text: You squint until your eyes water and learn nothing.

events.name: The Usual
events.intro: The barkeep looks you up and down. "The usual? Or have a look at the special. It changes every day. Nobody knows how."

success.text: A bowl of something warm. Your party feels it too.
The barkeep grins. "Chef's luck."

failure.text: It is, uh, memorable. Mostly the smell.

success.text: Fine. Water is fine.

events.name: A Meal on the Road
events.intro: A traveller is cooking over a tiny fire. "There is always enough for one more. Sit."

choices.label: Share a berry from your Bag

success.text: He tells you about a shortcut on the road ahead.
Fair is fair. He tells you what he knows.
He talks about everywhere he has been. It is enough.

events.name: Which Way?
events.intro: A local leans on a fence. They point confidently in two directions at once. "Depends who is asking."

success.text: They soften and tell you the way, exactly.

failure.text: They send you the long way round, grinning.

success.text: Money loosens everyone's memory.
Sometimes the right way is the one you did not ask about.

events.name: A Guide With Opinions
events.intro: "Fifty and I show you the quiet way." The guide taps a map. "Two hundred and I show you the secret one."

success.text: The quiet way is quiet. It shows you where the trainers are.
The secret way is a little steep, and worth it.
He shrugs. "Your feet."

events.name: The Tour Guide
events.intro: A tour guide in a bright cap is narrating a worn-down statue. "Stay for the whole story, and I add a secret at the end!"

success.text: It takes a while. The secret at the end is real, and a little sad.
You get the best part and none of the dates.
The guide waves. "The statue will be here."

events.name: The Masked Stranger
events.intro: A masked figure falls into step beside you. "A secret for a secret. You first." They never stop walking.

success.text: They nod. "Mine is worth more." They whisper the gym's weakness and vanish.

effects.text: A masked stranger traded you a secret.

success.text: They pause. "Now we are even." You learn where the stops hide.

failure.text: They laugh, thin and unkind. "Nice try." Your pocket is lighter.

success.text: The stranger tips an invisible hat and is gone.

events.name: The Apprentice
events.intro: A kid has been following you for an hour. "Please, may I watch? I will carry your bag. I will not talk." They already are talking.

success.text: They watch every choice you make. It is slightly unnerving.
They beam and show you a neat thing in return.
They go, shoulders low.

events.name: The Apprentice Remembers Your Kindness
events.intro: The kid from before catches up, taller somehow. "I copied what you did for the stranded Pokémon. It worked!"

success.text: They glow. A grateful parent hands you a thank-you gift.

events.name: The Apprentice Learned Your Tricks
events.intro: The kid from before blocks your path with an innocent look. "I copied what you did to that shopkeeper. Want to see?"

success.text: You buy their silence. A good lesson, for both of you.
You catch yourself in their mirror. You do not like it.

effects.text: The apprentice copied your worst habit.

events.name: A Wedding on the Hill
events.intro: Bells, ribbons, a crowd, two Pokémon wearing tiny bowties. A guestbook sits open at the gate. "Sign, and be lucky!"

success.text: Everyone cheers. A little luck follows you out.
The couple presses a lucky charm into your hand.
It is lovely. You leave quietly.

events.name: A Quiet Funeral
events.intro: A small funeral for a Pokémon, with candles and few words. The family looks up as you stop.

success.text: They nod. An elder presses something into your hand: a small relic.

effects.text: You paid your respects at a stranger's funeral.

success.text: You say a few words about a Pokémon you never met. They are grateful.
You do not intrude.

events.name: The Street Performer
events.intro: A guitarist plays a song that makes the whole street slow down. A hat sits open on the ground.

success.text: The song settles into your team like a warm coat.
It goes on for a while. Everyone feels lighter.
You stay till the last chord. They nod at you.

events.name: Cook Together
events.intro: A chef offers you the second pan. "Fast hands, steady heart. Can you keep up?"

success.text: Timing is everything. The meal is perfect.

failure.text: You burn the sauce. The chef pretends not to notice.

success.text: The chef grins. "Honest critic."
The kitchen smells wonderful behind you.

events.name: The Cooking Contest
events.intro: A judge in a tall hat is scoring dishes. "A trainer! Cook something your team would eat."

success.text: The judge's eyes close. Slowly, he smiles. A short montage of stars follows.

failure.text: The judge tastes it, pauses, and writes something short.

success.text: It is simple and good. The judge tears up.

failure.text: It was good, but nobody got it. You eat it yourself.

success.text: Great show.

events.name: The Travelling Doctor
events.intro: A doctor with a leather bag and a very honest price list. "Statuses cured. Hurts healed. No fee for the weeping."

success.text: A quick tonic. Everyone sits up straighter.
Two hours of care. Everyone is healed and a little sleepy.
The doctor sighs and halves the price.

failure.text: The doctor does not haggle with the unwell. Your pride takes the hit.

success.text: The doctor nods and puts the bag away.

events.name: The Trivia Mentor
events.intro: A silver-haired mentor folds her hands. "Answer three questions about Pokémon and I will teach you a move nobody remembers. The first: which type is immune to Normal?"

success.text: "Correct. Second: which is immune to Electric?" You say Ground. "Correct." She teaches you a trick.
"No." She sighs. "Try again in your next life."
"No. But a good guess." She nods kindly.
You talk your way through. She sees through you, and approves.

failure.text: She frowns at the bluff.

events.name: Tournament Registration
events.intro: A clerk with a clipboard glances up. "Name? Ah. I have your file." He flips a page and raises an eyebrow. "You have quite a record."

success.text: He stamps a card. "Good luck. The bracket will remember you."
He reads out highlights, and a few things you wish he would not.
He pencils a question mark by your name.

events.name: The Team Appraiser
events.intro: A critic steps out of a cafe, takes one look at your team, and starts talking without being asked.

success.text: "Hot-headed, but I admire the commitment."
"Deep and steady. A lovely line."
"A whole garden. I could stay here all day."
He criticises your coverage for a full minute. Some of it is useful.

events.name: A Mailbox With Your Name
events.intro: A mailbox leans on a post, a name chalked on it that looks suspiciously like a pen-pal's. A letter sticks out, unsigned.

success.text: You scribble something honest. It will find its way.
A berry, a stamp, and a doodle.
You walk on. The mailbox stays.

events.name: A Letter Waiting
events.intro: A courier presses a small envelope into your hand. "From someone who remembers you. They left this at the post office."

success.text: A short letter, a pressed leaf, and a few coins. "Keep going. I am reading about you."

events.name: The Collector's Swap
events.intro: A collector with pockets full of Poké Balls: "This one has a history. It has been in a flood, a fire and a quiz show. Swap?"

success.text: You trade. The new one arrives with a note: "Likes naps. Hates doors."

effects.text: A collector swapped you a Pokémon with a quirky past.

success.text: He shows you its photo album. It is charming.

events.name: Hold This Egg
events.intro: A harried stranger thrusts a warm egg at you. "Please! Five minutes! Hold it!" They are gone before you can answer.

success.text: It is warm and a little heavy. It hatches when you least expect.
They look relieved. "I will tell the owner."

events.name: Festival Dance-Off
events.intro: Lanterns, drums, a crowd. A dancer points at you and the circle opens. "Follow my arrows!"

success.text: You hit every beat. The crowd roars.

failure.text: You trip on the last step. Everyone laughs warmly.

success.text: It is not the dance, but it is something.

failure.text: They politely clap.

success.text: It looks like fun. You make a note of the steps.

events.name: Carnival Booths
events.intro: Three booths: ring toss, a shooting gallery, and a tub of berries to bob for. A barker waves at you. "Each ₽50. Win, and something shiny."

success.text: The ring spins, lands, and clinks. A prize!

failure.text: Close! The ring bounces off.

success.text: Bullseye. The barker is delighted.

failure.text: You miss by a mile.

success.text: A berry between your teeth. Everyone claps.

failure.text: You surface soaked and berry-less.

success.text: The barker sighs.

events.name: The Fishing Buddy
events.intro: An old fisher shares his bench. "Fish bite when you stop trying to catch them. Also: the east bend has the big ones."

success.text: He tells you where the rare ones hide. A fishing spot opens beside the road.
You catch nothing, and enjoy it.
He tips his hat.

events.name: The Case of the Missing Lantern
events.intro: A detective in a long coat is crouched over a tiny footprint. "A lantern is missing from the village square. Three clues, three stops. Will you help?"

success.text: He hands you a notebook. "First clue is by the well."

effects.text: You joined a detective on the Case of the Missing Lantern.

success.text: He nods and goes back to the footprint.

events.name: Clue: The Well
events.intro: By the old well there is a wet paw print and a scrap of ribbon. The detective peers at it. "What does it tell you?"

success.text: He nods, and points toward the next clue.
He frowns. "Hm. Maybe."

events.name: Clue: The Rooftop
events.intro: On the roof, a Pokémon sleeps with the lantern in its arms. The detective whispers: "Our thief. What do we do?"

success.text: The detective smiles. "A kind ending." He gives you a keepsake.
The village cheers. The sleeper sulks.

events.name: The Gossip Table
events.intro: Two regulars at a long table are trading stories, and cannot decide whose are better. "Settle this: which one is true?"

success.text: You hear about a shiny seen near the old bridge.
You hear about a lantern burning at the summit.

choices.label: Add a story of your own

success.text: They love it. It will be retold, and gradually ruined.

events.name: A Loud Argument
events.intro: Two villagers are arguing about who owns a prize-winning berry bush. They both turn to you at once. "Whose side are you on?"

success.text: The younger storms off. The elder gives you the best berries.
The elder grumbles. The younger gifts you a coin pouch.
It takes a while. Neither is happy; both are grateful.

failure.text: They both turn on you, then turn back to each other.

events.name: A Generous Loan
events.intro: A man in a sharp coat leans on a pillar. "Short on funds? I lend. Pay me back at the next stage, with a bit extra."

success.text: He counts it out. "A pleasure. See you soon."

effects.text: You took a loan from a stranger with a sharp coat.

success.text: He shrugs. "Offer stands. For a while."

events.name: The Debt Collector
events.intro: Three burly trainers block the road. "Boss says time is up. Pay ₽1000, or we settle this the other way."

success.text: They count it slowly and leave. The debt is cleared.
They come in hard.
You slip past. The debt follows you.

failure.text: They catch you and take a cut.

events.name: The Banker's Window
events.intro: A clerk at a window mutters: "Are you here to repay a loan? I can clear it before the collectors show up."

success.text: He stamps the paper. Debt cleared.
He shrugs. "They will find you first."

events.name: The Insurance Agent
events.intro: A smiling agent in a tidy suit opens a briefcase. "Nobody likes to talk about losing a Pokémon. Lucky for you, I do. One policy, one Pokémon, one saved memorial."

success.text: He stamps a paper. "If it falls, it does not stay lost. Terms apply."

effects.text: You bought a policy for your Pokémon.

success.text: He sighs and halves the premium.

failure.text: He closes the briefcase. "Not a good day for you."

success.text: He tips his hat. "Everyone comes round."

events.name: The Riddling Guard
events.intro: A guard blocks the gate. "I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but come alive with wind. What am I?"

success.text: "Correct." He opens the gate. Inside, a small tribute awaits.
"No." He crosses his arms.
"No." He keeps the gate shut.

events.name: Hands Across the Market
events.intro: A trader who does not speak your language gestures: three fingers, a flat palm, a circle. The market is loud. You are the only customer.

success.text: Three berries for one potion. Fair. You both beam.

failure.text: You buy the wrong thing. They are kind about it.

success.text: It works, kind of. You laugh together.
A pleasant misunderstanding.

events.name: Describe the View
events.intro: An old woman sits at a viewpoint. "I cannot see it, but I can hear it. Tell me what is out there?"

success.text: She smiles. "I can almost see them." She hands you a small gift.
She sighs happily. "That is right. That is what it is."
She pats the air where they stand. "Good company."

events.name: The Retired Champion
events.intro: A woman in a worn coat leans on a fence. "I used to hold a title. Spar with me, and if you can stand your ground, I will tell you something no one tells."

success.text: She smiles. "Let us see."
She tells you about the day she lost, and what she did next.
She nods. "Next time."

events.name: Two Rivals, One Bench
events.intro: Two young trainers sit on opposite ends of a bench, pretending not to look at each other. They both turn to you. "Tell us. Are we friends, or are we rivals?"

success.text: They exchange a glance. Slowly, they smile.
They grin and shake hands, fiercely. Something in the air gets competitive.
They laugh. "That sounds right."

events.name: The Old Ranger: Strangers
events.intro: The ranger squints at you from behind his fire. "Mind the fire. And the bear. The bear is friendly."

success.text: He says little, but he moves over to make room.
He takes it without a word. It is a start.
He lets you go.

events.name: The Old Ranger: Acquaintances
events.intro: "Back again." The ranger puts the kettle on without asking. "Tell me about the road."

success.text: He nods slowly. "Honest is rare."
He tells you which stops to trust, and which to skip.
He hums quietly.

events.name: The Old Ranger: Friends
events.intro: The ranger has a spare bedroll out. "For you. I made it last winter. Thought you might turn up."

success.text: You sleep better than you have in days.
He nods, and for once, speaks at length.

events.name: Gatekeeper Mara
events.intro: Mara guards a bridge and fights every traveller who wants to cross. She is good. She is also tired.

success.text: She yields. You help her up and say nothing about it.

choices.label: Beat her and take your due

success.text: You win and take what is on the bridge. She does not forget it.
She lets you pass with a nod.

failure.text: She blocks the bridge. "No."

events.name: Mara Remembers You
events.intro: Mara is waiting at the next bridge with a package. "I do not know why. I feel like I owe you."

success.text: A small trove of supplies. She will not say why.

events.name: Mara Remembers You, Too
events.intro: Mara's eyes lock on you from across the bridge. "I know you. I do not know how. I just know I do not like you."

success.text: She does not answer. But she lets you pass.
She is stronger. So are you.

events.name: The Farmer's Long Errand
events.intro: A farmer you have never met asks: "Would you carry this seed to a field three towns away? I would do it myself, but my knees." He does not seem to expect an answer.

success.text: It weighs almost nothing. You promise yourself to remember.

effects.text: You took a farmer's seed on a long errand.

success.text: He nods. "That is fine. Someone else, then."

events.name: The Farmer's Long Errand: Second Field
events.intro: The same farmer is waiting, though he does not know you. "A seed? To the field? Nice of you to offer. I once asked another stranger, long ago."

success.text: You plant it. A tiny green shoot catches the light.

events.name: The Farmer's Long Errand: Harvest
events.intro: The farmer's fields are green all the way to the horizon. He does not know your face. "Take what you like," he says. "I seem to have been lucky."

success.text: It is full of everything.
He shrugs. "For what?"

events.name: The Mentor's Tips
events.intro: A mentor you half-recognise falls into step. "I watched your last few choices. Here is what I noticed."

success.text: "You are good to your team. Remember they are also soldiers."
"Your edge is sharp. Do not dull your friends on it."
"You push hard. Rest sometimes."
"Check your team before every gym. Trust the small things."

events.name: A Familiar Face Steps In
events.intro: A veteran of one of your earlier runs appears at the roadside. "Need a hand?" They nod toward two trainers eyeing your party.

success.text: They step in beside your lead.
They tip their cap. "Another time."

events.name: Eve of the Gym
events.intro: The night before the gym, a stranger sits beside you on the steps. "Nervous? You can walk in loud, or quiet, or ask for advice."

success.text: The hall will remember it.
Calm settles over your team.
The stranger tells you what to expect from the leader.

events.name: Old Friends, New Run
events.intro: A stranger smiles like they know you. "I read about the last time. You really did that?"

success.text: They lean in. By the end, a small crowd has gathered.
They wink. "Of course you did not."

events.name: Three Cards
events.intro: The fortune teller fans three cards face down on a velvet cloth. "Pick one. It will follow you for a while, whether you like it or not."

success.text: A bright card. Your team will learn faster, and the road will push back.
A quiet card. Wild Pokémon trust you more, and healing is a little slower.
A kind card. Your team grows closer, and your pockets grow lighter.
"They will wait," she says.

events.name: The Glove on the Ground
events.intro: A trainer throws a white glove at your feet. "I challenge you. Properly. Accept it or refuse it, but do it in front of everybody."

success.text: A hush falls. Then a roar.
They sneer, then bow. "Another day."
The crowd laughs, and so does the challenger.

failure.text: The joke lands badly. The glove stays on the ground.

events.name: Out-levelled
events.intro: A veteran blocks the path, their team clearly stronger than yours. "You are in my way. Is there a reason I should not crush you?"

success.text: They hear you out. "Fine. Go." They step aside.

failure.text: "Not good enough." They send out their team.

success.text: You choose the harder way.
You find another road.

events.name: Your Fire-type Pick
events.intro: The trainer you advised is back with a Fire-type team. "I took your advice! Want to see if it was any good?"

success.text: They are proud, and so well drilled that it stings.
They glow. "Thanks for believing in me."

events.name: Your Water-type Pick
events.intro: The trainer you advised is back with a Water-type team. "I took your advice! Want to see if it was any good?"

success.text: They are proud, and so well drilled that it stings.
They glow. "Thanks for believing in me."

events.name: Your Grass-type Pick
events.intro: The trainer you advised is back with a Grass-type team. "I took your advice! Want to see if it was any good?"

success.text: They are proud, and so well drilled that it stings.
They glow. "Thanks for believing in me."

events.name: Pick a Team for Me
events.intro: A young trainer is staring at a list. "I have to pick a team and I cannot decide. What type would you build around?"

success.text: "Bold. I like it." They write it down.
"Reliable. I like it." They write it down.
"Gentle and sharp. I like it." They write it down.

events.name: The Scribe's Table: Badges and Rivals
events.intro: A scribe copies old pages by candlelight. "Take a page. They go to whoever reads them."

success.text: A page about a badge nobody can name.

choices.label: Read about the gym that lost

success.text: A short page about a sign hung face down.
A page about matching scars.
You leave it open for the next traveller.

events.name: The Scribe's Table: Storms and Markets
events.intro: Another scribe, another table. "Pages on the left are warnings. Pages on the right are lies. They look the same."

success.text: A page pinned to a gatepost, long ago.
A page about a market that appears after battles.
A page with more paw prints than names.
You leave it open for the next traveller.

events.name: The Scribe's Table: Legends
events.intro: The last scribe is nearly asleep. "Take a page, if you can find one that is not blank."

success.text: A page about weather that follows legends.
A page with a blank back and a single line on the front.
You leave it open for the next traveller.
